title: One-Roll Temple — What Particular Help Can It Provide

entries.value: Considerable healing blessings and holy physic
Unusually well-resourced for a shrine of this size
Owns a great deal of valuable goods, land, or livestock
Has the ear of important local lords or royal officials
The local lord relies on it considerably for legitimacy
Has useful lay servants and lay brothers
Knows a great many useful secrets and rumours
Can arrange for crimes or offences to be forgiven or overlooked
Is owed favours by other temples and monasteries
Has a surprising number of well-armed defenders
